author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Coalesces verified Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and optional TikTok live starts into one guarded Discord channel or forum notification.
changelog: 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial release with stable stream identity, multi-platform coalescing, channel/forum destinations, role mention validation, source-derived links, simulation suppression, and bounded persistent deduplication.

manifest.name: Live Beacon
installationSteps: Import the Live Beacon Streamer.bot package.
Put a private Discord webhook URL in its Set Argument, compile it, and run a harmless manual test.
Approve only its triggerless Deliver action, configure platform links/templates, then enable the add-on.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its bounded stream deduplication history remains preserved.

healthChecks.description: Confirms verified online events can coalesce into one guarded Discord delivery.
